card.name: Numbers and units in interaction studies
card.fires_on: Digits, spaces or unit pieces (micro, microM, micromolar) inside a numeric value, in drug interaction or in vitro study sentences. It fires on the number or unit just before a comparison sign or unit such as mg or microM.

modes.description: The gap or digit in an inhibition value such as IC50 >50 microM.
